items.exampleEn: Learning to drive was a real struggle for me.
items.exampleZh: 學開車對我來說真的很吃力。

items.exampleEn: Can you shift your chair a little to the left?
items.exampleZh: 你可以把椅子往左挪一點嗎？

items.exampleEn: The hotel is located right next to the beach.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店就位在海灘旁邊。

items.exampleEn: The new shop will generate many jobs for local people.
items.exampleZh: 這家新店會為當地人創造很多工作機會。

items.exampleEn: The photo captures the beauty of the sunset.
items.exampleZh: 這張照片捕捉到夕陽的美。

items.exampleEn: Click the link to see more photos.
The city launched a plan to plant more trees.
items.exampleZh: 市政府推出了一項多種樹的計畫。

items.sentenceEn: Can you help me locate the nearest bank?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以幫我找到最近的銀行在哪裡嗎？

items.audioEn: The team will launch the website next week, but the link is not ready yet.
items.audioZh: 團隊下週會推出網站，但連結還沒準備好。

items.sentenceEn: This camera can capture very clear pictures at night.
items.sentenceZh: 這台相機在晚上也能拍出很清楚的照片。

items.sentenceEn: Many workers shifted to working from home last year.
items.sentenceZh: 去年很多員工轉為在家工作。

items.stemEn: These machines ____ electricity from the wind.
items.stemZh: 這些機器利用風力發電。

items.stemEn: Scientists found a clear ____ between sleep and memory.
items.stemZh: 科學家發現睡眠和記憶之間有明顯的關聯。

items.passageEn: Last month, Emma lost her phone on a busy train. At first, it was a struggle to stay calm. Then she used her computer to locate the phone, and a map showed it at a station across town. A kind station worker had found it and kept it safe. To aid other travelers, the train company later launched a website for lost items. Each item has a photo and a link to a form. The site has already generated a lot of interest.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Emma 在擁擠的火車上弄丟了手機。一開始，她很難保持冷靜。後來她用電腦找出手機的位置，地圖顯示手機在城市另一頭的一個車站。一位好心的站務人員撿到手機並妥善保管。為了幫助其他乘客，火車公司後來推出了一個失物招領網站。每件物品都有照片和一個表單連結。這個網站已經引起很多人的注意。

questions.questionZh: Emma 怎麼知道手機在哪裡？
options: 一位朋友打電話告訴她的
用電腦找出手機的位置
後來在火車座位上找到的

questions.questionZh: 火車公司後來做了什麼？
options: 推出一個失物招領網站

items.promptZh: 這家公司打算明年推出新產品。
referenceEn: This company plans to launch a new product next year.
The company intends to launch new products next year.
rubricZh: 「打算」可寫 plan to、intend to、be going to 等
產品可用單數或複數（例如 a new product、new products）

items.promptZh: 這所大學位於一座小山上。
referenceEn: The university is located on a small hill.
This university is located on top of a small hill.
rubricZh: 用 be located 表示「位於」（例如 is located on…；寫 is on a small hill 也正確）
